notes.title: Great update!
notes.content:
[h2]New combat system[/h2]
The combat system of the game has been completely redesigned. There was a block, dash, crits and a system for increasing and decreasing damage. Also in the game you can now find additional weapons to increase your damage.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40621122/c99e1c0952ffb8988fa63020ef7b1ae86b70281e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40621122/cff6249b9a767423c517009dd7ec7c3954a7c5cf.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Controller support[/h2]
Full support for XBox controller. The controller now works both in the menu and in the game.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40621122/f776d1140573d3e7cbbbec2987510889d841478b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40621122/3b1efc4b8ccd41eec72e436990d8f661f84d92f8.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Serbo-Croatian localization[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40621122/a6d6df18ca7a532dcbba56a8189c3a578206d8c7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40621122/9bb2288db604b4977f50e60c19972683c43986a7.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Ultimate bug fix[/h2]
Fixed some inhuman amount of bugs found during the finalization of the game. There is a broken save/load, and camera zoom, and broken dialogues, and UI, and etc.

[h2]And more...[/h2]
All enemies, artificial intelligence, dialogues, UI and much more have also been reworked. It looks like I accidentally made another game. So play and write a review. Thank you in advance!
